structure: Part 20, adding a transporter that is not on the list. Read in full: commercial-transporter-details.fit.spec.js (describe 'adding a commercial transporter that is not on the list', 9 tests at lines 142-265; describe 'commercial transporter form accessibility', 2 tests at 331 and 342) and transporters.fit.spec.js (describe 'adding a transporter that is not on the list', 9 tests at lines 573-683), plus all 20 trace zips the partition names, each opened and mined: every action, the frame snapshots of every transporter page, and the browser network log. Refs name a trace by the hash part of its folder (commercial-t-3037e, -89fa5, -9bd01, -6cbe9, -11d4a, -15566, -ff364, -ec025, -ddddd, -43e29, -82a00; transporters-f13e0, -652d3, -438f1, -b4f2f, -d8c54, -6a6f2, -71a45, -46b7b, -6c105). Every trace walks the same set-up: stub sign-in, start a notification, origin France, commodity Felis catus with 1 animal, then Arrival details saved blank, which redirects to the transporter list. Pages in order: (1) Transporter details list at /live-animals/notifications/{ref}/transporters, caption 'Transport and arrival', with the secondary 'Add a transporter' button (a link styled as a button) - only its add entry point and how added rows show is claimed here; (2) the type question 'Choose a transporter type' at /transporters/add, caption 'Add a new transporter', warning text, a visually hidden legend and two radios (Private transporter, Commercial with a hint), only 'Save and continue'; an error state for an out-of-list value; (3a) Commercial branch: 'Add commercial transporter' at /transporters/add/commercial - notification banner of authorisation guidance, authorisation number, name, address lines, town, county, postcode, a disabled Country select fixed to Northern Ireland with a hidden country field, an 'Enter contact details' heading, email and phone (with hint), only 'Save and continue'; its error state for a blank authorisation number; save redirects to the Overview; (3b) Private branch: 'Add private transporter' at /transporters/add/private (heading, caption, intro, fields and a country select of 34 options seen here; its own validations belong to other parts). Conditional: 3a only after Commercial, 3b only after Private; the ?change=1 context carries from the list to the type question. Cross-notification: a transporter added on one notification appears, marked New, on the transporter list of the organisation's next notification. Network log shows only browser-to-frontend calls (GET/POST with 302 redirects); no backend or address-book call is visible in the browser log. Both axe checks (form, and form in error) recorded an empty violation list.
